source_divergence.controller_prepare_fixtures_behavior: Writes retrieved FLEURS audio bytes directly to a .wav path, then validates with Python stdlib wave before gate/model execution.
source_divergence.f2_comparator_observed_behavior: Contains an explicit soundfile decode plus sf.write(format='WAV', subtype='PCM_16') canonicalization path before wave-based validation.
source_divergence.interpretation: The failing controller comparator and the F2 comparator are not behaviorally identical at the fixture materialization boundary. Repair must target the actually executed controller comparator or bind the controller to the canonical comparator artifact; patching an unrelated copy cannot close the runtime defect.

external_primary_research.finding: Python 3.13 stdlib wave supports only uncompressed PCM WAV; IEEE-float format tag 3 is not accepted.
Python 3.15 adds WAVE_FORMAT_IEEE_FLOAT support, making float-WAV acceptance Python-version-dependent.
soundfile supports explicit WAV subtype selection; WAV default subtype is PCM_16 and explicit subtype='PCM_16' is valid.
Hugging Face Audio may expose decoded audio or original bytes/path; decode=False preserves source bytes/path rather than guaranteeing a PCM16 WAV ABI.
NeMo-Speech.cpp documents common mono/stereo PCM WAV handling for local ASR; a stable PCM fixture boundary is aligned with the downstream runtime contract.

counterhypotheses.hypothesis: Upgrade Python so wave accepts IEEE-float WAV directly.
counterhypotheses.reason: This would make fixture validity depend on Python minor version and still does not satisfy the WebRTC-VAD PCM16 contract. It also changes the runtime dependency surface instead of repairing the explicit fixture ABI.

counterhypotheses.hypothesis: Treat format tag 3 as a Nemotron product failure.
counterhypotheses.reason: The failure occurs before model transcription; no Nemotron inference result exists.

counterhypotheses.hypothesis: Patch only the F2 comparator copy.
counterhypotheses.reason: The observed failing run executes the controller-repository comparator bytes. A repair not bound to the actually executed comparator cannot close the evidence-validity defect.
